<?php
require_once 'wordpress/wp-load.php';

if ( ! class_exists( 'WC_Product_Simple' ) || wc_get_products( array( 'limit' => 1 ) ) ) {
	return;
}

$term = term_exists( 'Demo Collection', 'product_cat' );
if ( ! $term ) {
	$term = wp_insert_term( 'Demo Collection', 'product_cat' );
}
$category_id = is_array( $term ) ? (int) $term['term_id'] : (int) $term;

$examples = array(
	array(
		'name' => 'Everyday Canvas Tote',
		'description' => 'A lightweight everyday tote with reinforced handles and a roomy interior.',
		'short_description' => 'A simple carryall for daily errands.',
		'price' => '24.00',
		'sku' => 'DEMO-TOTE-001',
	),
	array(
		'name' => 'Weekend Trail Pack',
		'description' => '',
		'short_description' => '',
		'price' => '68.00',
		'sku' => 'DEMO-PACK-002',
	),
	array(
		'name' => 'Pocket Field Notebook',
		'description' => 'A compact notebook for quick notes and sketches.',
		'short_description' => 'Made for ideas on the move.',
		'price' => '9.50',
		'sku' => '',
	),
);

foreach ( $examples as $example ) {
	$product = new WC_Product_Simple();
	$product->set_name( $example['name'] );
	$product->set_status( 'publish' );
	$product->set_catalog_visibility( 'visible' );
	$product->set_description( $example['description'] );
	$product->set_short_description( $example['short_description'] );
	$product->set_regular_price( $example['price'] );
	$product->set_sku( $example['sku'] );
	$product->set_category_ids( array( $category_id ) );
	$product->save();
}
